Definition
[Divergence and nondivergence form] 1. ch6:6.1-def-1\group Elliptic PDE Let \[ (2) \qquad Lu = -\sum _{i,j=1}^n \left(a^{ij}(x)u_{x_i}\right)_{x_j} + \sum _{i=1}^n b^i(x)u_{x_i} + c(x)u \] or else \[ (3) \qquad Lu = -\sum _{i,j=1}^n a^{ij}(x)u_{x_ix_j} + \sum _{i=1}^n b^i(x)u_{x_i} + c(x)u, \] for given coefficient functions $a^{ij}, b^i, c$ $(i,j=1,\ldots ,n)$.

The PDE is in divergence form for (2) and nondivergence form for (3); $u=0$ on $\partial U$ is the Dirichlet condition.
